quests.instruction: Fruits grow from the flowers of a plant and carry its seeds. Which of these is a fruit?
quests.hint: It is sweet and has a core with seeds.
quests.explanation: A pear grows from a flower and holds seeds inside. A carrot is a root and lettuce is made of leaves.
quests.funFact: Growers usually pick pears while they are still firm, and the pears finish ripening afterward.

quests.instruction: Cheese, butter and milk are all dairy foods. Which one can you pour into a glass?
quests.hint: It takes the shape of whatever holds it.
quests.explanation: Milk is a liquid, so it pours. Cheese and butter are solid foods made from milk.
quests.funFact: Milk is mostly water, with fat, protein and natural sugar mixed in.

quests.instruction: Which food is usually sprinkled with salt, giving it a salty taste?
quests.hint: Someone often shakes salt over it while it is still hot.
quests.explanation: French fries are salted after cooking, so they taste salty. Honey and mango are naturally sweet.
quests.funFact: People have used salt for thousands of years to flavor food and to help keep it from spoiling.

quests.instruction: A market stall has a sign that says Vegetables. Which food belongs under it?
quests.hint: The part you eat grows on a thick green stalk.
quests.explanation: Broccoli is a vegetable, so it belongs under the sign. Cherries and peaches are fruits.
quests.funFact: Broccoli is a close relative of cabbage and cauliflower.

quests.instruction: Which of these is normally eaten warm, fresh from the oven?
quests.hint: The cheese on top is soft and bubbly.
quests.explanation: Pizza is baked, so it is served warm. Ice cream is frozen and watermelon is kept cool.
quests.funFact: A classic Margherita pizza has red tomato, white mozzarella and green basil, the colors of the Italian flag.

quests.instruction: What food is crunchy enough to snap when you bite it?
quests.hint: You can hear it when you chew.
quests.explanation: A raw carrot is firm, so it snaps with a crunch. Yogurt is creamy and a banana is soft.
quests.funFact: Carrots contain natural sugars, which is why they taste a little sweet.

quests.instruction: Lemons, limes and green apples can make people scrunch up their faces. Which taste do they share?
quests.hint: Ask yourself how your cheeks pucker.
quests.explanation: Foods taste sour when they contain natural acids. Sweet is the taste of sugar and salty is the taste of salt.
quests.funFact: Many fruits are sour when they are unripe and turn sweeter as they ripen.

quests.instruction: Which fruit is soft enough to squish with a fork?
quests.hint: Its inside turns almost mushy when it is ripe.
quests.explanation: A ripe banana has soft flesh that mashes easily. Apples are firm and pineapples are tough.
quests.funFact: Bananas turn from green to yellow as the starch inside them changes into sugar.

quests.instruction: What food is a fruit that has had its water dried out so it keeps for a long time?
quests.hint: It is wrinkled and chewy.
quests.explanation: Raisins are grapes that have been dried. Watermelon and strawberries still hold lots of water.
quests.funFact: Drying removes water, and the germs that spoil food need water to grow, so dried foods keep well.

quests.instruction: Bread, rice and pasta all belong to the same food group. Which group is it?
quests.hint: Consider the seeds of grassy plants.
quests.explanation: Bread, rice and pasta are made from grains such as wheat and rice. Dairy comes from milk and fruits grow on plants.
quests.funFact: Wheat, rice and corn are all grains that grow on grass-like plants.

quests.instruction: A bag of peas is kept in the freezer until it is hard and icy. What do we call food stored this way?
quests.hint: Think about how cold the freezer is.
quests.explanation: Food stored in the freezer is frozen. Dried food has lost its water, and fresh food has not been stored or changed.
quests.funFact: Many vegetables are frozen soon after they are picked, so they keep their color and taste.

quests.instruction: Which side dish is soft and smooth, with no crunch at all?
quests.hint: A spoon sinks right into it.
quests.explanation: Mashed potatoes are cooked until soft and then crushed smooth. Popcorn and apples both crunch.
quests.funFact: Mashing breaks cooked potatoes into tiny pieces, which is why they feel smooth.

quests.instruction: Which food is dry and crumbly instead of juicy?
quests.hint: It leaves crumbs on the plate.
quests.explanation: A cookie is baked until it is dry, so it crumbles. Oranges and watermelon are full of juice.
quests.funFact: Cookies turn out crisp or chewy depending on the amount of butter and sugar and how long they bake.

quests.instruction: Two of these foods are vegetables. Which one does not belong with them?
quests.hint: It is sweet and grows on a tree.
quests.explanation: Carrots and broccoli are vegetables. An apple is a fruit, so it is the odd one out.
quests.funFact: Apples float in water because a good part of each apple is made of air.

quests.instruction: Meat, fish, eggs and beans are called protein foods. Which of these is a protein food?
quests.hint: It comes from an animal.
quests.explanation: Chicken is a meat, so it is a protein food. Grapes are fruit and bread is a grain food.
quests.funFact: Protein is one of the nutrients our bodies use to grow and repair themselves.

quests.instruction: Milk, cheese and yogurt all belong to which food group?
quests.hint: Ask yourself which animals give us milk.
quests.explanation: Foods made from milk are dairy foods. Grains come from plants like wheat and protein foods include meat and beans.
quests.funFact: Dairy foods contain calcium, a mineral that helps build strong bones and teeth.

quests.instruction: A smoothie, a pancake and a glass of milk are on the table. Which one is not a drink?
quests.hint: You need a plate, not a cup.
quests.explanation: A pancake is a solid food that you eat with a fork. Smoothies and milk are liquids that you sip.
quests.funFact: Many cultures celebrate pancakes on special days, such as Shrove Tuesday in the United Kingdom.

quests.instruction: Which of these is usually served cold?
quests.hint: Its vegetables are fresh and uncooked.
quests.explanation: A salad is made of fresh vegetables that are not heated. Soup and oatmeal are served warm.
quests.funFact: The word salad comes from a Latin word meaning salted.

quests.instruction: Which of these would you find in a fruit bowl on the kitchen table?
quests.hint: It is sweet and a little tangy.
quests.explanation: A kiwi is a fruit, so it fits in the fruit bowl. Onions and broccoli are vegetables.
quests.funFact: Fresh kiwi fruit contains a substance that stops gelatin from setting, so cooks avoid mixing them.

quests.instruction: A farmer picks a strawberry this morning and sells it at the stall this afternoon. How would you describe the strawberry?
quests.hint: It has not been stored or changed in any way.
quests.explanation: Food that is recently picked and has not been preserved is fresh. Canned and frozen foods are stored in other ways.
quests.funFact: Fresh fruit is best eaten soon, because it spoils faster than dried or canned fruit.

quests.instruction: What food can add a spicy, burning heat to a dish?
quests.hint: A tiny piece can make your mouth feel hot.
quests.explanation: Chili peppers are spicy. Bell peppers and cucumbers are mild and do not make your mouth burn.
quests.funFact: Chili peppers get their heat from a natural chemical called capsaicin.

quests.instruction: Which fruit has a thick outer layer that people peel off and throw away?
quests.hint: A tough covering protects the juicy part inside.
quests.explanation: An orange's thick peel is not eaten. We can eat the skin of an apple or a grape.
quests.funFact: Orange peel can be grated into zest, which adds flavor to cakes and other foods.

quests.instruction: Which of these fruits is usually the biggest?
quests.hint: One fruit can feed many people at a picnic.
quests.explanation: A watermelon can be as big as a basketball or even bigger. Cherries and grapes are tiny.
quests.funFact: Watermelons grow on vines that creep along the ground.

quests.instruction: Which of these is savory instead of sweet?
quests.hint: You would eat it for lunch, not dessert.
quests.explanation: Savory foods taste salty or rich rather than sugary. A hot dog is savory, while cupcakes and donuts are sweet.
quests.funFact: Savory foods often get their flavor from salt, herbs and spices instead of sugar.

quests.instruction: What food is hard and brittle in the box but turns soft after it is cooked in boiling water?
quests.hint: Dry pieces snap if you bend them.
quests.explanation: Dry pasta soaks up water as it cooks, which makes it soft. Bread and bananas are already soft.
quests.funFact: Dried pasta swells as it cooks, growing bigger and softer.

quests.instruction: Which bread is chewy and shaped like a ring with a hole in the middle?
quests.hint: It is dense, with a shiny crust.
quests.explanation: A bagel has a thick, chewy texture. Pancakes and cupcakes are light and soft.
quests.funFact: Bagel dough is boiled briefly before it is baked, which makes it chewy.

quests.instruction: Which of these snacks is a fresh fruit?
quests.hint: It grows on a plant close to the ground.
quests.explanation: A strawberry is a fruit that grows on a plant. Donuts and pretzels are baked from dough.
quests.funFact: Strawberry plants spread by sending out long stems called runners across the ground.

quests.instruction: Use all three clues: it is crunchy, it is green and it is a vegetable. Which food matches?
quests.hint: Check the clues one at a time.
quests.explanation: Lettuce is crunchy, green and a vegetable. A green apple is crunchy and green but a fruit, and a carrot is a crunchy vegetable but orange.
quests.funFact: Lettuce comes in many types, such as romaine, iceberg and butterhead.

quests.instruction: Two of these are grain foods. Which one is not?
quests.hint: One of them comes from an animal.
quests.explanation: Pasta and rice come from grains. Cheese is made from milk, so it belongs with dairy foods.
quests.funFact: Wheat is ground into flour, which is how bread and pasta are made.

quests.instruction: Which of these is not a dairy food?
quests.hint: It comes from a hen, not from milk.
quests.explanation: Eggs belong with protein foods because they come from birds. Yogurt and cheese are made from milk.
quests.funFact: In many shops eggs sit beside milk and cheese, which is why people often mix them up.
